title: Slovakian Fried Pistachio Fritters
description: A crispy, sweet, and savory dessert inspired by traditional Slovakian cuisine. Fried to perfection, these fritters are a delightful treat any time of the year.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Add the chopped pistachios to the dry mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the wet mixture to the dry mixture and stir until a smooth dough forms.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the dough into the hot oil, flattening them slightly with a spatula.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
